mainEntity.name: How much does a minicab from Waltham Cross EN8 to Heathrow Airport cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard saloon from Waltham Cross EN8 to Heathrow starts from £72, fixed at the point of booking with no additional charges once the journey is complete.

mainEntity.name: How long does the journey from Waltham Cross EN8 to Heathrow by minicab take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical Waltham Cross EN8 to Heathrow minicab journey takes between 50 and 70 minutes via the A121 to the M25 at Junction 25, then anticlockwise on the M25 westbound to Junction 15 and the M4 westbound into the Heathrow terminal approach roads, covering approximately 30 miles.

mainEntity.name: Do LTR Minicab drivers offer meet and greet at Heathrow for Waltham Cross EN8 passengers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our meet and greet service positions your driver inside the arrivals hall with a name board, ready to assist with luggage directly to the vehicle. 45 minutes of complimentary waiting time is included on every airport booking.

mainEntity.name: Are LTR Minicab drivers serving Waltham Cross EN8 fully licensed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every driver holds a valid TfL private hire licence and all vehicles are maintained and insured to private hire standards.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a fixed price Waltham Cross EN8 to Gatwick or Luton minicab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every Waltham Cross EN8 to Gatwick or Luton minicab booking through LTR Minicab is priced upfront and stays fixed regardless of traffic conditions on the day.
